data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘n-w-f’, meaning 'to be kind, generous, or benevolent'. In Islamic tradition, Nayef is a name of Prophet Yusuf's (Joseph) noble character, embodying kindness and generosity. The name Nayef carries the meaning “Gracious, generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nayef usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
